bibl.title: The Last Demotic Inscription.
bibl.seg: Eugene Cruz-Uribe, The Last Demotic Inscription.

Koenraad Donker van Heel, Francisca A.J. Hoogendijk & Cary J. Martin (edd.), Hieratic, Demotic and Greek Studies and Text Editions. Of Making Many Books There Is No End: Festschrift in Honour of Sven P. Vleeming = Papyrologica Lugduno-Batava. XXXIV (Leiden - Boston, 2018) pp. 6-8, figg.
bibl.note: GPH [Eugene Cruz-Uribe, The Demotic Graffiti from the Temple of Isis on Philae Island = Material and Visual Culture of Ancient Egypt. 3 (Atlanta, 2016)] 939 was probably the last Demotic inscription ever written [when the temple of Philae was already closed, thus after 538].
